rating_definitions.substantial: Original/specialist page-level evidence independently compared and tied to verified physical site interpretation.
rating_definitions.developing: Explanatory historical arc demonstrable but important original or site verification remains.
rating_definitions.sparse: Source is single, derivative, uncertain, or lacks chronology/site anchor.
rating_definitions.missing: Required site access, rights, independent evidence, or original documentation absent.
